newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-TOMBA OFFERED TV ROLE IN "SNOWBALL".
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-TOMBA OFFERED TV ROLE IN "SNOWBALL".

text.p: Olympic and world champion Alberto Tomba is considering a new career in acting and has been offered a role in a Hollywood television series that would be called "Snowball", his father said on Monday.

Franco Tomba told reporters in this northwest resort that Tomba had started training again after suffering a knee injury and hoped to return to competition in Madonna di Campiglio on December 17 -- two days before his 30th birthday.

He also said Tomba, who has considered retiring after winning two gold medals at the world championships in Spain last February, had thought about going into acting and was offered a role in "Snowball".
"There have been many film requests...but they must be examined in detail," he said, giving no further details.
Tomba injured his knee last month while training on a glacier in Italy, forcing him to miss Sunday's first World Cup slalom at Park City, Utah. Thomas Sykora of Austria won the race.
